prerequisites: Prior knowledge from Production and Logistics Fundamentals is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain the basic idea and philosophy of Lean Management and Lean Production.
Students can explain the connection between Industrial Engineering and Lean Management and take it into account in practical operations.
Students can identify waste in the company.
Students can explain typical Lean methods and tools and apply them as needed in the operational context.

Students can describe, plan, and improve work systems in the company taking into account ergonomic, technical, and work organizational aspects, and determine and use actual and target data on work and production systems, e.g., quantity and times.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, definition and demarcation of Industrial Engineering, Lean Management and Lean Production
Fundamentals of work and production systems
Systematics for planning and designing work and production systems
Selected methods for data collection and data evaluation
Selected rules, methods and tools for work system design
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
